behaviorMappings.name: does not reserve an SDK-owned Native change while the Native mutation lock is held
behaviorMappings.retiredMechanism: Native mutation callback held an ordinary exclusion lock and a nested public SDK start had to fail without registering an owner. Current mutation callback only checks real unfinished business transactions.

target.fullName: Runtime JSON command starts a Native SDK Run through a serial mutation without replacing its existing owner or state

behaviorMappings.expected: Current v4 SDK start succeeds in a serial mutation despite untouched obsolete lock artifacts; same start is idempotent, conflicting task fails RUN_CONFLICT, original owner, logical Run/state, physical checkpoint bytes and formal state presence/bytes remain unchanged.
behaviorMappings.forbidden: Treating ordinary callbacks as a live writer lock; asking for a stop/token handshake; overwriting existing owner, Run or original checkpoint; modifying obsolete historical lock artifacts.
